Compare F(donor)-F(receiver) edits at final query, last copied-value source, and both. Two reciprocal task directions, nuisance key-rename and identity. Source position found from the intended answer token in each prompt; token-validity failures retained in exclusions, no outcome filtering.
competence_gate: Per format >=4validpairs, >=.75bothendpoint choice, >=.5 intended full-vocabulary top1. Nuisance correctness reported separately. Relative effect error only if competence passes and full effect RMS>=.25logits.
limitations: New panel relative to H732/H747; not asserted absent from pretraining. Handwritten limited task family. Source and final edits change different computations. No downstream node clamps, no task fitting.
